history.title: Establishment of Forsyth County
history.description: Forsyth County was created by the Georgia General Assembly from part of the Cherokee County territory, named in honor of John Forsyth, 33rd Governor of Georgia and Secretary of State.

history.title: Construction of Poole's Mill Covered Bridge
history.description: The iconic Town lattice-truss covered bridge was built across Settendown Creek by Bud Gentry. It remains a cherished historical landmark in Ball Ground / Forsyth County.

history.title: Creation of Lake Lanier & Buford Dam
history.description: The US Army Corps of Engineers completed Buford Dam on the Chattahoochee River, forming Lake Lanier with nearly 38,000 acres of water surface and 692 miles of shoreline.

history.title: Modern Commercial & Cultural Growth
history.description: The opening of Halcyon (2018) and the new Cumming City Center provided Forsyth County with vibrant pedestrian villages, outdoor amphitheaters, and thriving local business hubs.
